headline: Seedpin sprint: b19 SuperMario, b20 RaccoonHeist and the emulator tier merge — pin floor 55
lede: Slot a carried the #1473 rollout this cycle while slot b verified the queue dry and stepped aside. Three seedpin batches plus an ADVENTURE polish pass landed on main; the pin floor rose from 53 to 55 and Zork, King's Quest and Ultima I-V now carry honest seedless reports.

notes.text: SuperMario (b19, #1546) and RaccoonHeist (b20, #1548) joined the seedpin rollout — RaccoonHeist threads ?seed=N straight into the guard-timing engine, so filed reports replay the exact heist; pin floor 53→55.
Emulator tier (b21+b22, #1550): DosShell carries {tick,score,done} for Ultima I-V, KingsQuest and Zork their own honest shape — binary ROMs get seedless reports, not fake seeds.
ADVENTURE polish pass #1545 shipped: magnet attract + dragon respawn, both gated (#1549).
Slot b's honest-dry audit: all four flagship READMEs hold zero open gaps, every ladder rung empty — two correctly-refused claim attempts, zero double-work between slots.
